notes.title: Patch Notes 1.50.1018
notes.content:
[h2]Discord Competition Winners[/h2]
There was a competition in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/DAbKavXHVG]snekflat enthusiasts Discord[/url] to create a new hat & a new insect and everyone voted for their favourites. The winning entries have been added to the game.

[b]Seagull Hat[/b]
Wool came up with the seagull hat. This ended up becoming a new feature. I always felt bad for players when nothing would happen after they managed to hit a bird with a bug net (which is pretty tricky to do). So now you can catch birds with the bug net and wear them as hats.

[b] "Sliamk" Insect[/b]
This purple snail-like insect was designed by wupporulz(forever)ok. There are 10 different insects in the game now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44214266/7b8e3855e823d0053cff10e3408d4f66e9486cb1.png[/img]

[b]Other[/b]
Full credits list is now also available from the Title Screen.

Cheers,
Lars (snekflat)

notes.title: v1.36.1206 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello.
[h3]Another update![/h3]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
- Insect Probability: increases the chance to spawn insect types you haven't caught before.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed the game not being able to shut down when trying to exit from a soccer match or bumper car battle.
- Fixed the "cursed" tree where cars would keep driving in circles south of Sky Plaza.
- Fixed the cars spawning behind the rocks around Poedelstark & Mokernakt.
- Fixed an issue that occurred if you jumped into a car from inside an elevator as the elevator was closing.

Cheers!
Lars (snekflat)

notes.title: v1.36.0055 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello again! 

[h3]Here's another quick update:[/h3]

[b]Accessibility[/b]
Gameplay Settings: Added a toggle to disable "Tilted Camera Angles". This is toggled on by default. If you turn it off, the game will have alternated camera angles in most of the interiors, which should be helpful if you find the tilted camera discomforting (or nauseating).

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a few missing characters in the Chinese font.
- Fixed some issues related to Post Processing.

Cheers!
Lars (snekflat)

notes.title: v1.34.1831 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello again!

[h3]Here are the patch notes for the latest version:[/h3]

[b]Enhancements[/b]
- The Turbo Junk Finder Hat now also beeps nearby entrances to buildings that still have uncollected Turbo Junk.
- The Turbo Junk Finder Hat now also beeps nearby Ricky if he still has Turbo Junk in his pocket.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the Gameplay Settings don't show the applied settings after re-launching the game.
- Fixed the shovel sometimes not working as expected on slopes.
- Fixed the mini map not opening if you tried opening it immediately after closing it.
- Fixed some lighting issues in The Generator.
- Fixed an issue with some hat descriptions not displaying when acquiring the item.

[b]Achievement revalidation[/b]
- If somehow the Mushroom Chime achievement didn't trigger for you, it should now be revalidated when you load your save file or enter a map.

Cheers!
Lars (snekflat)

notes.title: v1.33.1654 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

[h3]Here's a bunch of changes, based on your feedback.[/h3]

[b]Accessibility[/b]
- Gameplay Settings: Added a toggle for screen shake.
- Gameplay Settings: Added a FOV slider.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
- Added DirectX12 support (Experimental). Vulkan still recommended if your graphics card supports it.
- Added resolutions: 1280x800 (Steam-Deck), 1366x768

[b]Graphics Setting: Shadow Quality[/b]
The quality of the shadows is now more customizable.
- To get the same quality level as before the update with shadows toggled on: set the Shadow Quality to High.
- To get the same quality level as before the update with shadows toggled off: set the Shadow Quality to none.

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Lowered the price of most cosmetic items.
- Increased the range of the Turbo Junk Finder Hat by 25%.
- Earn an additional 15 Turbo Junk (or money) after defeating Ricky. The total amount of junk has not increased, Ricky will just run out faster.
- Earn an additional amount of money after winning a soccer match, equal to how many goals you scored more than the opposite party.
- Bumper Car Battle: You can now also hit Ricky's car if you released the Turbo button a bit early, but still have significant speed.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed ending a phone call early in one of the late-game phone dialogues.
- Implemented a fix in case a Turbo Trash Can doesn't come along with you after hitting it.
- Can't go into screenshot mode anymore when looking through binoculars.
- Fixed Terry's head being deformed if you land on the ground right before picking up an item.
- Fixed that Terry's Car sometimes falls through the ground when using a parking sign.
- Fixed an issue where terry was able to hit Ricky's car once more after the battle ended.
- Fixed some issues regarding not being able to enter your car after battling with Ricky.
- Fixed a few holes in the ground.
- Fixed the game displaying 100% before actually having all the turbo junk.

[b]Other[/b]
- Implemented save file backups, as well as a feature that tries to revert a save file in case something went wrong during saving. If this happens through the main menu, gameplay should continue and you can try again.

Cheers!
Lars (snekflat)

notes.title: v1.30.1806 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I have been smiling all day reading your reviews <3

[h3]Here are the patch notes for the latest version[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a setting to the Gameplay Settings that allows you to scale the UI. Currently this affects the size of the mini map and the legend on your full screen map, as there was high demand for these specific elements for Steam-deck users. I may add more elements in the future!
[*] “Achievement: Get 450 Turbo Junk” should now also unlock regardless of whether you’ve upgraded the Turbo Junk into Turbo Ups.
[*] Corrected the credits from saying “Super Rage Originals” to “Super Rare Originals” xD
[*] Fixed an issue that occurred if your car fell into the water while you were in a menu or dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where you had to press a random button on your keyboard to continue the dialogue if you managed to press space & mouse click on the exact same frame when rushing through dialogues.
[*] Fixed an issue where the government quest doesn’t show up in the progress window once you completed it.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could interact with plastic chairs that were placed inside of a wall.
[*] Fixed a typo in one of the dialogues, of one of the gummy pup resting grounds statues.
[*] Fixed a confusing collider in the beach area nearby the Beach Club.
[*] Can no longer eat beach fries from your car (which introduced a broken animation).
[/list]
Cheers!
Lars (snekflat)

notes.title: TINY TERRY PLAYTEST THIS WEEKEND 📣
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Terry Enthusiasts! [/h3]

We are looking for the chosen one (x15~30) for a closed playtest for TTTT!

The goal of this test is to get feedback on the user experience. Whether you can find the content. Whether you have fun, etc. This will be extremely helpful in ironing out the design of the game and making sure I'm not missing the mark on (expected) features!

Some notes: [list]
[*] The game is still under development and its current state does not represent the intended final quality in terms of visuals/audio/polish & stability. Some parts are still very crappy xD
[*] The game currently requires a pretty good PC set up, as some of the planned performance optimizations are not in place yet.
[*] The game currently requires a gamepad. The KB&M controls are still terrible 
[*] Participants can be listed in the game's credits if they want
[/list] [h2]More details & sign up here: [url=https://forms.gle/teChsPeAZrHCFECp9]https://forms.gle/teChsPeAZrHCFECp9[/url][/h2]
